depth_findings.text: Needed before switch-on: the 2-image Ask turn through the real inference-core vision adapters (Azure/OpenAI and Anthropic) is unproven. The chain test only checks the InferRequest the gateway sends to a scripted provider.

The client gate is a build-time VITE switch that mirrors the server switch. If the two drift, either images are blocked that the diversion would serve, or images reach a server that falls back to AnalyzeImage. A server-declared attachment_policy.modes.vision_as_parts in /v1/models (http_routes.rs, WS10 shares it) would remove the drift.

The vision route check uses the unfiltered inference-core ListModels. It does not apply the org's model-access policy or the user's picked provider, so a vision model the org cannot use can make a Verevon mode look image-capable. inference-core's server-side vision_unsupported refusal is the safety net.

No test drives the prompt-too-long shed retry with images present (rebase() is unit-tested only). No multi-turn chain test shows prior history and memory reaching the model with images, because the session mock has no history.

The plan's golden rows (Ask, image, ZDR/waived/persistent) in zdr_posture_matrix.rs and api/contracts/zdr-posture-matrix.json were not added: the matrix enumerates postures, not features, and the fixture copy must stay byte-identical. zdr_feature_table.rs already covers the refusals. Add a (vision parts, ZDR) row if the feature table grows nested fields.
The too_many_images sentence in no.ts and en.ts still reads 'only N image can be analyzed' and does not read well for N=4.

toStreamAttachments' per-turn budget error and the attachment_do_unsupported wording are bare Norwegian in chat-normalizers.ts (3 new no-restricted-syntax lint errors, the file's existing pattern). Move them into i18n.tr at render time.

vision.rs select_image stays as the fallback per D5. The plan says delete it one release after the flag default flips (never for Do). Image token cost reaches the usage frame only through provider usage (WS27).

A hosted image URL with no bytes is refused (attachment_encoding_invalid) on the parts path, because inference-core takes bytes only. The diversion accepted URLs. Owner may want the URL case to fall back to the diversion instead.

The client gate is a build-time VITE switch mirroring the server switch, so drift is possible. If they disagree, either images the diversion would serve get blocked, or images reach a server that falls back to AnalyzeImage. Declare modes.vision_as_parts server-side in /v1/models.

route_reads_images uses the unfiltered inference-core ListModels. It ignores org model-access policy and the user's provider pick, so a Verevon mode can look image-capable when the org cannot use any vision model. inference-core's vision_unsupported refusal is the only safety net and would fail the turn instead of falling back to the diversion.

The chain test asserts tools reach the model and the index holds across rounds, but not that prior history and memory reach it, which the plan row lists. The prompt-too-long shed retry with images is covered only by the rebase() unit test.

attach() has a debug_assert that the carrier message still sits at user_index. If bind() found no user-role message (carrier None), that assert fires in debug builds, and release builds send index 0. The prompt always ends with a user turn today, but it is untested.

The ListModels call sits on the hot path before the run row, once per image turn when the switch is on. It has no cache and no timeout visible in the diff, so a slow inference-core delays the first byte. Failure falls back to the diversion, which is fine.
A hosted image URL with no bytes is refused (attachment_encoding_invalid) on the parts path, where the diversion accepted URLs. The owner may prefer fallback to the diversion for that case.

results.notes:
What was built, all off by default.

Server: CHAT_VISION_AS_PARTS_ENABLED (only the literal "true" enables it).
- vision_parts.rs holds ImageParts, admit(), route_reads_images(), attach() and rebase().
- sse.rs admits images before any run row exists:
  - Do plus image is refused with attachment_do_unsupported.
  - ZDR plus image is refused again, defence in depth.
  - ListModels is asked only when the switch is on and the turn has images. The picked model answers for itself, and a Verevon mode follows "some vision model exists".
  - If the catalogue call fails, or no model reads images, the vision_stream diversion serves the turn as before.
- With parts, the diversion is skipped. The images are bound to the last user message right after the prompt is rendered.
- tool_loop.rs: run_tool_rounds_for_model and run_tool_rounds_for_model_with_attachments take images as a last parameter, and every round's InferRequest carries them. A debug_assert pins that rounds only append.
- The final answer's InferRequest carries the images too. On prompt-too-long shedding, rebase() re-finds the carrier message by role and content. If that message was itself shed, the turn fails like any too-long prompt.
- Switch off: the admission code yields an empty ImageParts, nothing is attached and the diversion runs. The flag-off chain test shows the diversion called once and no image part sent.

Client:
- chat-client.ts: VISION_CAPABILITY and modelSupportsVision(model, policy, {verevonMode}).
- attachment-policy.ts: new reason model_no_vision, with an optional imageParts context. When present, the model must read images and the declared maxImages applies. Absent, behaviour is unchanged.
- The client gate is switched by VITE_CHAT_VISION_AS_PARTS_ENABLED, default off, to be flipped together with the server switch. This is needed because the declared policy cannot say whether the server flag is on, and an always-on gate would block images that work today through the diversion.
- DashboardComposer.tsx feeds the context into evaluateAttachments.
- chat-normalizers.ts: attachment_do_unsupported presentation in both switches, and a per-turn byte budget in toStreamAttachments (the declared maxTotalBytes, else 3,145,728).
